description: Weapon Mastery feats (one per weapon) and Fighting Style feats (weapon-pair styles). General feats, most with Level 4+ prerequisite. Additive to D&D 5e — does not replace core combat.

features: Combined Assault: Battleaxes and warhammers gain Light and the Nick mastery.
Shock and Awe: Damaging the same target with both weapons in one turn denies reactions/bonus actions and halves speed until end of their next turn.

The Thunder: Replace one attack — all creatures in a 5-ft emanation make a CON save (DC 8 + PB + STR) or take 3d6 thunder and be deafened until end of your next turn (half damage, no deafen on success). Audible 100 ft.
fighting_style_feats.name: Anvil of Thunder Style
fighting_style_feats.prerequisite: Level 4+, proficiency with warhammer and battleaxe

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Arm Strength: Battleaxes gain the Light property.
Close In: Wielding battleaxe/handaxe + dagger, a damaging attack lets you start a special grapple (no free hand needed to maintain).
Closing Jaws: While maintaining the grapple, weapon attacks vs the target have advantage and deal +2 damage per turn the grapple has been maintained (dagger/handaxe/battleaxe only).
fighting_style_feats.name: Bear Fang Style
fighting_style_feats.prerequisite: Level 4+, proficiency with battleaxe or handaxe

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Blasting Mask: Wield blowguns with your mouth (no hand needed). No disadvantage within 5 ft.
Slashing and Piercing: Every 2nd scimitar attack lets you fire a wielded blowgun as part of it.
Battle Lungs: Hold breath twice as long. +5 ft speed. Inhale gas in a 5-ft square (disadvantage on its saves) to clear it.
fighting_style_feats.name: Blowgun and Scimitar Style
fighting_style_feats.prerequisite: Level 4+, proficiency with blowgun and scimitar

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Batter Up: Make dart attacks while wielding a greatclub — double range, +1d8 piercing.
Hammering the Nails: Greatclub attacks deal +1 piercing per dart that has hit the target (removable with an action).
Piercing Club: Store PB darts in your greatclub; embed one per attack (+1 Hammering count, +1d4 piercing while any remain). Reload as an action.
fighting_style_feats.name: Greatclub and Dart Style
fighting_style_feats.prerequisite: Level 4+, proficiency with greatclub and dart

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Piton Precision: Treat pitons as daggers (including mastery). Warhammers gain Light.
Secure Hold: Piton+hammer attacks can attach a piton to the target — you move when they move (may share space). Removable with an action (DC 15 Athletics).
Recover Pitons: Replace one attack to rip all pitons back — each one ripped from a creature deals 1d6 + STR force damage.
fighting_style_feats.name: Hammer and Piton Style
fighting_style_feats.prerequisite: Level 4+, proficiency with warhammer or light hammer

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Hammering Approach: Longswords and warhammers gain Light and the Nick mastery.
Hammer and Anvil: Damaging one creature with both weapons in a turn knocks it prone.
Hammer the Blade: Once per turn, replace one attack — combined longsword + warhammer damage as slashing, ignores resistances, add ability modifier once.
fighting_style_feats.name: Hammer's Edge Style
fighting_style_feats.prerequisite: Level 4+, proficiency with longsword and warhammer

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Unexpected Punctuation: During an all-greatsword Attack action, draw, fire, and stow a hand crossbow.

Rappelling Shot: Fire a roped bolt as full movement — travel 50 ft in a straight line (no OAs), stow as part of it. If you travel 30+ ft then attack with a greatsword, the first attack deals +3d6 slashing.
The Second One: When firing a hand crossbow, throw your greatsword at the same target (thrown range = crossbow range). Not usable with Unexpected Punctuation.
fighting_style_feats.name: Hand Crossbow and Greatsword Style
fighting_style_feats.prerequisite: Level 4+, proficiency with hand crossbow and greatsword

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Strained Grip: Wield a maul with the same hands as your greataxe. Disarm effects remove only one weapon.
Densely Packed Strikes: While wielding both, maul/greataxe attacks deal +2d6 and may be bludgeoning or slashing.
Brutal Impact: PB times per short rest, replace one attack — 15x15 ft square, one roll vs all inside, damage rolled once.
fighting_style_feats.name: Maul and Greataxe Style
fighting_style_feats.prerequisite: Level 4+, proficiency with greataxe and maul

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase any ability score by 1, max 20.
features: Magic/Martial Similarity: Gain morningstar proficiency. Cast identify at will (wands only). Use any ability modifier for morningstar attacks while wielding a wand.
Martial Wand: When you activate a wand with your action, make one morningstar attack as part of it.
Derived Essence: Dealing damage with a wand grants your morningstar +1d8 of that damage type until your next short rest (reusable to change type, not stack).
fighting_style_feats.name: Morningstar and Wand Style

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Secure Shielding: Strap a shield to the same arm as your axe — grants half its AC bonus (rounded up).
Weighted Impact: Once per shield per turn, add the shield's AC bonus to the damage of a landed axe attack.
Balanced Axes: Battleaxes and handaxes gain Light and the Nick mastery.
fighting_style_feats.name: Shielded Axe Style
fighting_style_feats.prerequisite: Level 4+, proficiency with battleaxe or handaxe, and shields

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase one ability score by 1, max 20.
features: Spark the Slicer: Daggers are spellcasting foci. Dagger attacks deal +PB damage of the last spell's type cast through the dagger.
Slice and Spark: During an Attack action with a dagger, cast one touch cantrip at the same target as part of the action.
Spark and Slice: When casting a damaging spell with range >10 ft, throw a dagger at one of its targets as part of the same action.
fighting_style_feats.name: Spellrazor Style
fighting_style_feats.prerequisite: Level 4+, can cast a touch cantrip

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Blade, Spike, Hook, Butt: Choose slashing, bludgeoning, or piercing per halberd attack.
Warding Reach: +2 AC until start of your next turn when you attack with a halberd.
Spinning Assailment: During a halberd Attack action, make one extra attack dealing 1d4 bludgeoning.
fighting_style_feats.name: Spinning Halberd Style

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Nauseating Impacts: Bludgeoning damage (weapon or unarmed) can force a CON save (DC 8 + PB + STR/DEX); failure = poisoned until end of your next turn.
Mountain's Ward: As a reaction, expend a hit die to reduce damage taken by the roll.
Three Points: 3 separate bludgeoning instances vs one creature in a turn unlocks a reaction dealing PB x PB necrotic/psychic/force damage until your next turn begins.
fighting_style_feats.name: Three Mountains Style

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Quick Net: Once per turn, use a net as part of a trident attack (before or after). Reaction to retract the net vs attacks on it (their action still expended).
Flop the Fish: +1d6 vs restrained creatures; +2d6 with a trident vs restrained.
Reinforced Restraining: Net DCs = 8 + PB + ability mod. Nets have 25 HP, 15 AC.
fighting_style_feats.name: Trident and Net Style

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Slow and Steady: Shortsword attack + shield + heavy armor = no opportunity attacks against you for the rest of the turn.
Readied Defense: Reaction shortsword attack vs creatures entering your reach (requires heavy armor + shield).
Deadly Emplacement: Reduce speed to 0 for the turn to make your shortsword 1d10 until end of turn (not if you moved >10 ft).
fighting_style_feats.name: Turtle Dart Style
fighting_style_feats.prerequisite: Level 4+, proficiency with heavy armor, shield, shortsword

fighting_style_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Torch Training: Torches deal 1d6 fire, gain Light and the Nick mastery.
Blinding Light: Damaging with torch + another weapon in one turn blinds the target until end of your next turn.
Heated Steel: Wielding torch + metal weapon, add PB fire damage to the non-torch weapon.
fighting_style_feats.name: Weapon and Torch Style

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Disarming Assault: When you inflict damage with a battleaxe (Graze damage excluded), you may halve the damage to remove one held item from the target. With a free hand you may grab it; otherwise fling it up to 20 ft (may target another creature with the same hit/damage roll, damage type at DM discretion).
Sweeping Strikes: Battleaxes you wield gain the Cleave Weapon Mastery. You can always use the Weapon Mastery of any battleaxe you wield.
Bypass Shield: Battleaxe attacks ignore the target's shield AC bonus.
weapon_feats.name: Battleaxe Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase any ability score by 1, max 20.
features: Trained Lungs: Ignore the loading property for blowguns. Range becomes 50/200 ft.
Venomous Spit: Blowgun needles deal +1d12 poison damage (or 1d8 psychic if target is immune to poison).
Paralytic Agent: PB times per long rest, a needle that dealt poison damage forces a CON save (DC 8 + ability mod + PB); failure = paralyzed until your next turn.
weapon_feats.name: Blowgun Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Quality Clubbing: Clubs gain Finesse and the Topple Weapon Mastery. You can always use the Weapon Mastery of any club you wield.
Distraction Cudgel: Attacking a target within 5 ft of an ally with a club changes its damage from 1d4 to 1d12.
Staggering Impact: Creatures damaged by your clubs cannot make opportunity attacks until their next turn.
weapon_feats.name: Club Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Sneaky Stabbing: Hidden dagger attacks deal +2d6 damage (same type). Stacks with Cunning Strike dice.
Non-cumbersome: While wielding only daggers, Stealth checks have advantage.
Precise Technique: Daggers gain thrown range 30/90 and the Sap Weapon Mastery.
weapon_feats.name: Dagger Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Dexterity or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Consistent Spread: Dart attacks against the same creature gain +1d4 piercing per hit after the first (1st: 1d4, 2nd: 2d4, 3rd: 3d4...). Resets at end of turn.
Circle It: Missing with a dart lets you move 5 ft without provoking opportunity attacks; your next dart attack has advantage.
Master of the Throw: Darts gain the Light property and the Nick Weapon Mastery.
weapon_feats.name: Dart Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Obtuse Angle: Flail attacks ignore the target's shield AC, OR 2 AC, OR AC from a reaction (choose one).
Fulcrum of Force: PB times per short rest, declare a Full Force Swing before rolling — all damage dice are maximized, but a miss deals the damage to you instead.
Ball and Chain: Flails deal 1d12 and gain the Graze Weapon Mastery.
weapon_feats.name: Flail Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Whirling Assault: One glaive attack roll can target a second creature in reach; roll damage once, apply to both.
Reach and Reposition: Once per turn as part of an attack action with a glaive, move 5 ft without provoking OAs or move a struck creature 5 ft.
Distracting Rings: Creatures damaged by your glaive take -2 to attack rolls until end of your next turn.
weapon_feats.name: Glaive Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Axe Aficionado: Greataxes gain the Graze Weapon Mastery.
Warding Swings: Taking the attack action with a greataxe increases your AC by PB until start of your next turn.
Skull Splitter: Greataxe crits triple (not double) damage dice. Crit range expands by 1 (e.g., 19-20).
weapon_feats.name: Greataxe Mastery

features: Wooden Wallop: Greatclubs deal +1d8 bludgeoning damage.
Technical Teak: Greatclubs gain the Vex and Sap Weapon Masteries.
Tested Timber: +1 AC while wielding a greatclub.
weapon_feats.name: Greatclub Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Halberdier: Halberds gain the Push Weapon Mastery.
Multi-Faceted: Halberd attacks may deal bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing (choose).
Anti-Cavalry: Maximize one damage die vs mounted targets/mounts. Advantage on Athletics to dismount while wielding a halberd.
weapon_feats.name: Halberd Mastery

features: Ricochet & Return: Thrown handaxe (target within 20 ft) applies the same hit/damage roll to 2 targets within 20 ft. Thrown handaxes return to hand.
Hindering: Handaxes gain the Slow Weapon Mastery.
Secure Ascension: Wielding 2+ handaxes grants climb speed equal to your speed.
weapon_feats.name: Handaxe Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Dexterity or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Quick Aim: Hand crossbows gain the Nick Weapon Mastery.
Quick Draw: When rolling initiative, you may make one hand crossbow attack.
Shoot and Tumble: After a hand crossbow attack, move 5 ft without provoking OAs (before or after the attack).
weapon_feats.name: Hand Crossbow Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Dexterity or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Weighty Shots: Heavy crossbows gain the Slow Weapon Mastery; range becomes 150/600.
Armor Piercing: Ignore 2 AC from natural or worn armor.
Portable Ballista: Damage becomes 1d12. Double damage to objects/structures.
weapon_feats.name: Heavy Crossbow Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Constitution, or Dexterity by 1, max 20.
features: Horseless Technique: Always considered mounted for lance features requiring it.
Piercing Momentum: Lance attacks may strike one additional target within 5 ft of the first; roll once, apply to both.
Destructive Delivery: PB times per long rest, once per turn after moving 15+ ft, shatter your lance to add your Strength SCORE (not modifier) as bonus damage. Destroys the lance.
weapon_feats.name: Lance Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase any ability score by 1, max 20.
features: Better Handling: Loses loading and two-handed properties.
Added Pressure: When you use your action for anything but Attack, you may make a light crossbow attack as a bonus action.
Tinkering Touch: 1 hour of work grants a light crossbow +1 AC and range 100/400.
weapon_feats.name: Light Crossbow Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Trained Swings: Light hammers gain Topple mastery; damage die becomes 1d6.
Beat to Death: +1d12 vs prone creatures. Creatures damaged this way spend ALL movement (not half) to stand.
Erect Fortification: As an action with materials/terrain, create a 5x5 ft square of 3/4 cover.
weapon_feats.name: Light Hammer Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Constitution, or Dexterity by 1, max 20.
features: Compound Strength: Add Strength modifier to longbow damage (in addition to Dex).
Called Shots: May apply Slow, Sap, Topple, or Push mastery to longbow attacks.
Prepared Position: If you start your turn where you started last turn, your first longbow attack has advantage.
weapon_feats.name: Longbow Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Hand and a Half: Damage becomes 1d10 (1d12 versatile). Gains Finesse and the Vex mastery.
Point and Edge: May deal piercing or slashing.
Sword of the Body: Before your first longsword attack on an Attack action, make a kick attack (counts as longsword for proficiency/mastery/properties; damage = ability modifier only).
weapon_feats.name: Longsword Mastery

features: Dazing Strike: Maces gain the Slow Weapon Mastery.
Armor Denting: If all attacks of an Attack action target one creature, that creature's AC is reduced by 2 after the action (regardless of damage).
Ball on a Stick: PB times per short rest, add Strength modifier twice to one mace attack's damage.
weapon_feats.name: Mace Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Crushing: Ignore resistance to bludgeoning damage.
Mauler: Mauls gain the Push Weapon Mastery.
Pulverize: PB times per short rest, replace one maul attack with Pulverize — normal attack, plus reduce target's AC by your PB on a hit.
weapon_feats.name: Maul Mastery

features: Armor Ripping: Dealing damage with a morningstar reduces the target's AC by 1.
Long Hafted: 1 hour customization grants Versatile (1d12), Reach, and the Slow mastery.
Exploit Sundering: +1 piercing damage per point of AC the target has lost to AC-reducing effects.
weapon_feats.name: Morningstar Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Solid Construction: A musket can be used as a greatclub (same properties).
Packed Powder: Expend an attack to pack the musket; next shot within 1 minute deals +1d12 piercing. Noisy.
Mild Rifling: Range becomes 100/400. Gains the Graze mastery.
weapon_feats.name: Musket Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Damaging Distance: +PB damage for every 5 ft between you and the target.
Pole Vaulting: PB times per turn, spend 10 ft of movement to traverse 20 ft, ignoring difficult terrain/ground hazards.
The Greatest Invention: Reach +5 ft. Pikes gain the Slow mastery.
weapon_feats.name: Pike Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Dexterity or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Gun-Fu: Pistols gain the Light property and the Sap mastery.
Close Quarters: No disadvantage within 5 ft of enemies.
Improvised Reloader: During a short rest, craft PB x 10 bullets. Spend 100 gp or a CR 5+ creature's body for +2 damage per bullet.
weapon_feats.name: Pistol Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase any ability score by 1, max 20.
features: Ancient Technique: Quarterstaffs gain Finesse, Reach, and the Push mastery.
Vaulting Assault: After moving 10+ ft, make a leaping kick as part of a quarterstaff attack (damage = ability modifier only).
Assisted Traversal: Ignore difficult terrain while wielding. Reduce falling damage by 1d6.
weapon_feats.name: Quarterstaff Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Main Gauche: Rapier + dagger grants +2 AC from the dagger.
Practiced Technique: Rapiers gain the Light property and the Graze mastery.
Successive Piercing: Your second rapier attack each turn is applied twice (roll once, apply hit and damage twice).
weapon_feats.name: Rapier Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Whirling Dervish: While dual-wielding scimitars, damaging attacks also deal your attack ability modifier in slashing to all other creatures in reach.
Inescapable: Scimitars gain the Slow mastery.
Two Hands!: Dual-wielding scimitars: each attack grants a Light-property off-hand attack (no chains). Add ability modifier to all off-hand damage. All can be part of the same Attack action via Nick.
weapon_feats.name: Scimitar Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase any ability score by 1, max 20.
features: The Best Defense: Shields become weapons (1d4 bludgeoning, Thrown 20/60, Topple mastery).
Bashing: When you take the Attack action, make one shield attack as part of it.
Portable Cover: As a reaction, grant yourself half cover until start of your next turn.
weapon_feats.name: Shield Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Dexterity or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Second Arrow: Expend an extra arrow to add +1d6 to a shortbow attack.
Hamstringing Shot: Shortbows gain the Slow mastery.
Disengaging Shot: As a bonus action, fire at a creature within your reach (no melee penalty); on a hit you disengage and move 10 ft.
weapon_feats.name: Shortbow Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Precise Piercing: Shortswords gain the Sap mastery.
Testudo: +1 piercing per point of your AC above 19 (e.g., 21 AC = +2).
Close Quarters: Advantage on opportunity attacks with shortswords.
weapon_feats.name: Shortsword Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength, Constitution, or Dexterity by 1, max 20.
features: Sickle Skills: Sickles gain Finesse and the Graze mastery.
Sickle Storm: Once per turn, replace one attack — one roll applied to all creatures in reach, damage rolled once applied to all.
Sharpen Sickles: Replace an attack to grant all wielded sickles +2 slashing until end of your next turn.
weapon_feats.name: Sickle Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase any ability score by 1, max 20.
features: The Bigger They Are: +1d6 bludgeoning per size category the target is larger than you.
Skirmishing: Once per turn, take the Dash action as part of a sling attack.
High Impact: Loaded slings count as clubs; gain Finesse and the Push mastery.
weapon_feats.name: Sling Mastery

features: Braced: Creatures entering your reach while you wield a spear take piercing = your Strength modifier.
Extended Grip: Spears gain Reach; damage becomes 1d8 (1d10 versatile).
Warding Swing: Once per turn, replace a spear attack with a bludgeoning Warding Swing that lets you move 5 ft without provoking OAs.
weapon_feats.name: Spear Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Ocean's Skewer: Gain swim speed = your speed (+10 ft while wielding a trident).

Sword Catcher: PB times per short rest, as a reaction when attacked with a melee weapon, force a STR or DEX save (DC 8 + ability mod + PB); failure disarms the attacker (weapon lands within 15 ft; mundane weapons break).
Tri-Point Technique: Damage becomes 3d4; gains the Push mastery.
weapon_feats.name: Trident Mastery

features: Can Opener: Ignore up to 3 AC from natural or worn armor.
Hammer Back: Change all war pick damage to bludgeoning.
Blunt and Tear: Bludgeoning damage causes the next piercing instance that turn to gain +2d6; piercing causes the next bludgeoning instance to gain +2d6.
weapon_feats.name: War Pick Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength or Constitution by 1, max 20.
features: Cracking Open: PB times per short rest, make a Cracking attack — if target has 15+ AC, reduce their AC by 4.
Putting Your Weight Behind It: +1 bludgeoning per 100 lbs you weigh, or your CON modifier.
Breach and Clear: Advantage on checks to break walls/doors/chests (must describe warhammer use).
weapon_feats.name: Warhammer Mastery

weapon_feats.asi: Increase Strength or Dexterity by 1, max 20.
features: Continues Cracking: After a whip attack, immediately attack with a different light weapon you wield (no chains).
Wrist Exercise: Whips gain the Light property and the Topple mastery.
Powerful and Thunderous: Change whip damage to thunder or force.
weapon_feats.name: Whip Mastery
